newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Cardinal Health Q4 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Cardinal Health Q4 net income rises.

text.p: Pro Forma Results excluding nonrecurring charges (b): Operating Earnings
Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding:

(a) For the 1997 fourth quarter, results for Owen Healthcare Inc reflect the three months ended June 30, 1997. For prior periods in fiscal 1997, Owen's fiscal quarters were the three months ended August 31, 1996 (first quarter), November 30, 1996 (second quarter) and March 31, 1997 (third quarter). For fiscal 1996, Owen's fiscal quarters were the three months ended February 28, 1995 (first quarter), May 31, 1995 (second quarter), August 31, 1995 (third quarter) and November 30, 1995 (fourth quarter).

(b) Pro forma operating earnings, net earnings and earnings per common share for the three months ended June 30, 1996, exclude the effects of nonrecurring charges of $49,698,000 ($35,338,000, net of tax) associated with the one-time expenses incurred in connection with the merger with Pyxis Corporation.
